seoTitle: Duotone Image Generator: Two-Color Photo Effect
metaDescription: Map a photo between a shadow colour and a highlight colour for a duotone look. Free, browser only, the image is never uploaded.
intro: Converts a photo to luminance and maps dark to your shadow colour and light to your highlight colour.
why:
Duotone images are common in posters and hero banners. Each pixel brightness is looked up between two colours. A contrast control lifts or flattens the mapping.

The luminance uses Rec. 709 weights on the gamma encoded values, a simple and common approach. The output is a PNG or JPG made locally.
howTo: Enter the shadow and highlight colours.
Run it and download the result.

faq.a: A dark saturated colour for shadows and a bright warm or cool one for highlights.
No. The output has the same pixel size.
PNG keeps any transparency flat; this tool outputs opaque pixels.
